text: Idi Lunes, impakaammo dagiti siyentipiko ti Stanford University School of Medicine ti pannakaaramid ti baro a gamit a mangkita a mangilasin ti klase ti selula: maysa a bassit a maimprenta a chip a mabalin a maaramid bayat ti panagusar ti normal a pagimprenta nga inkjet a posible nga agbalor ti maysa a sentimo ti U.S. kada maysa.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Ibaga dagiti nangyun-una iti panagsirarak a mabalin a makatulong daytoy tapno nasaksakbay a maammuan ti kanser, tuberkulosis, HIV, ken malaria kadagiti pasiente iti napapanglaw a pagilian, a sadiay a mabalin a kagudua laeng ti makalaslasat kadagiti sakit a kas iti kanser ti suso no idilig kadagiti nabakbaknang a pagilian.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

eng_text: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Nangrugi ti protesta iti 11:00 oras a lokal (UTC+1) idiay Whitewall bangir ti pagserrekan a naguardiaan ti polis a mapan idiay kalsada ti Downing, nga isu ti opisial a residente ti Primero a Ministro.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Kalpasan la unay ti 11:00, binangenan dagiti agprotprotesta ti trapiko ti agpaamianan a carriage idiay Whitehall.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Idi 11:20, sinaludsudan dagiti polis dagiti agprotprotesta nga umakarda nga agpalikod idiay bangketa, ibagbagada a kasapulanda nga ibalanse ti karbenganda nga agprotesta iti maur-urnong a trapiko.
eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Idi banda 11:29, napan idiay Whitehall ti protesta, banda iti Trafalgar Square, idiay Strand, nalabsan ti Aldwych ken ken Kingsway a mapan iti Holborn no ayan iti Partido Konserbatibo a naangay ti Spring Forum idiay Grand Connaught Rooms nga hotel.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

eng_text: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: Ti “Panama Papers” ti awag para kadagiti mangbukel a pagaraup sangapulo milion a dokumento nga aggapu iti opisina ti abogado a taga-Panama a Mossack Fonseca, ti naiwaras kadagiti agipabpablaak idi primabera ti 2016.
eng_text: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Impakita dagiti dokumento a sangapulo-ket-uppat a banko ti timmulong kadagiti babaknang a kliente a mangilemmeng iti kinabaknangda nga agpateg iti binilion a doliar ti US tapno maliklikanda dagiti buis ken dadduma pay a regulasion.
eng_text: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

eng_text: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

eng_text: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Iti laksid dagitoy a pammabasol, linaklaka ni Ma ti nangabak iti plataporma a mangiganggannuat iti nadekdekket a pannakikadua iti Mainland China.

eng_text: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

eng_text: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Ni Piquet Jr. ket nadungpar idi 2008 Grand Prix ti Singapore kalpasan laeng ti nasapa a panagsardeng ti pit para kenni Fernando Alonso, a nangiruar ti pangtalged a lugan.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Idi apan dagiti luglugan idiay Alonso tapno agpa-gas bayat ti sidong ti lugan a natalged, pinaakarna dagiti tattao tapno agballigida.
eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Naribbek ni Piquet Jr. kalpasan ti 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

eng_text: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

eng_text: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Ti pabuya a PBS ket addaan ti nasurok a dua a dosena a pammadayaw iti Emmy, ken iti panagtarayna ket naaab-ababa ngem Sesame Stree ken Mister Roger's Neighborhood.
eng_text: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Tunggal bennegna daytoy a pabuya ket naipamaysa ti tema idiay espisipiko a libro ken sarakenna dayta a tema babaen ti naduma-duma nga istoria.
eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Kada pabuya ket mangted met iti rekomendasion no ania dagiti libro a masapul a biroken dagiti ubbing no mapanda iti libraria.
eng_text: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: Kinuna ni John Grant, manipud iti WNED Buffalo (home station ti Reading Rainbow) a ti “Reading Rainbow ket nangisuro kadagiti ubbing no kasano ti agbasa,… ti panagayat iti panagbasa — aw-awisen ti [ti pabuya] dagiti ubbing a mangala ti libro ken agbasa.”
eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Mamati ti dadduma, agraman ni John Grant, nga iti krisis ti panagpundo ken panagbaliw ti pilosopia ti panagprograma kadagiti pang-edukasion a telebision ket isu iti nakaigapuan ti panangisardengda kadagiti pabuya.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Ti bagyo, nasarakan iti agarup 645 milya (1040 km) laud dagiti isla ti Cape Verde, ket mabalin a matunaw sakbay a mapeggadanna ti aniaman a lugar ti daga, ibaga dagiti forecaster.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Ni Fred ket addaan ti angin nga 105 a milia kada oras (165 km/h) ti agdama ken agturturong iti amianan a laud.
eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Ni Fred ti kapipigsaan pay laeng a nairekord a tropikal a bagyo iti abagatan ken daya ti Atlantiko sipud pannakaimbento ti satellite imagery, ken daytoy pay laeng ti maikatlo a kangrunaan a bagyo nga adda iti rekord iti daya ti 35˚W.
eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Idi Setiembre 24, 1759, nagpirma ni Arthur Guinness ti 9,000 a tawen a panangabang ti St James' Gate Brewery idiay Dublin, Ireland.
eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Kalpasan ti 250 a tawen, ti Guiness ket dimmakkel ken nagbalin a sangalubungan a negosio a kumitkita ti nasurok a 10 bilion nga euro (US$14.7 bilyon) kada tawen.
eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Ni Jonny Reid, kadua nga agmanmaneho para iti grupo nga A1GP New Zealand, ti nangaramid iti pakasaritaan ita nga aldaw babaen ti kapardasan a panagmanehona a legal iti 48 ti tawenna a Rangtay ti Auckland Harbor iti New Zealand.
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Naiturong ni Mr Reid ti kotse ti New Zealand nga A1GP, a Black Beauty ti kapaspas a sumurok 160km/h a maminpito iti rangtay.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Iti polis ti New Zealand ket addaan ti yengyengna ti panagusarda ti paltog a speed radar tapno makita no kasano ti kinapartak ni Mr Reid gapu ta kasta kababa ti Black Beauty, ken ti kanito a naorasan ti pulis ni Mr Reid ket idi bimmuntog isuna ti 160km/h.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Iti naglabas a 3 a bulan, nasurok 80 a naarestar ti napalubusan a rumwar ti pasilidad ti Central Booking a saan a nakaswan.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ti Abril daytoy a tawen, maysa a temporary restraining order ti inted ni Judge Glynn laban ti pasilidad a mangpatungpal ti pannakabulos dagiti nakemmeg ti napalabas ti 24 nga oras kalpasan nga iti pannakaunegda ket saan a nakaawat ti pannnakangngeg ti mangidaulo ti korte.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Nangiyetnag ti komisioner iti piansa, no maited, ken maipormal dagiti darum nga impila ti opisial a nagaresto. Kalpasanna, maiserrek dagiti darum iti computer system ti estado a pangkitaan iti kaso.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Iti panagdengngeg ket minarkaanna met ti petsa ti karbengan ti pagat-atapan para ti napartak a panangsubok.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Ni Peter Costello, tesorero a taga-Australia ken ti lalaki a nalabit a sumukat ken Prime Minister John Howard kas lider ti grupo Liberal ket imbatona ti suportana para ti industria ti nuklear a pwersa.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Imbaga ni Mr Costello nga iti panangaramid ti pigsa a nuklear ken agbalinen a makaya ti ekonomia, iduron koma ti Australia ti panagusar kadagitoy.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “No agbalin a komersial daytoy, masapul a maaddaantayo. Kayatna a sawen nga awan ti prinsipio a mangkontra iti nuklear nga enerhia” kuna ni Mr. Costello.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Segun iti Ansa, “maseknan dagiti polis iti pannakapapatay ti dua a nangangato a dadaulo a pagam-amkanda a mabalin a mangirugi iti maysa a naan-anay a gubat ti panagsisinnukat iti mangidaulo.
eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Kinunana ti polis a ni Lo Piccolo ket adda ti nangatngato nga imana ta isuna ti makinkannawan nga ima ti Povezano idiay Palermo ken ti dakdakkel a kapadasanna ti nangpangabak kenkuana ti panangdayaw ti natataengan a henerasion dagiti amo bayat ti panagsurotda ti kalintegan ti Povenzano a kasapulan nga agtalinaed a nababa mientras a patpatibkerenda ti turay ti koneksionda.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Niriendaan ni Provenzano dagitoy nga amo idi ginibusanna ti gubat nga iturturong ni Riina a kontra iti estado a nakatayan dagiti kontra iti Mafia a da Giovanni Falcone ken Paolo Borsellino idi 1992.
eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Imparang ti CEO ti Apple a ni Steve Jobs ti alikamen babaen ti pannagnana a napan iti entablado ken innalana ti iPhone manipud iti bulsana.
eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Kabayatan ti 2 nga oras a diskursona inbagana nga “Ita ti Apple ket mangbaliw iti telepono, mangaramid kami ti pakasaritaan a pasamak ita”.
eng_text: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Ti Brazil ti kadakkelan a Romano Katoliko a pagilian ti Lubong, ken ti Simbaan ti Romano Katoliko ket agtultuloy a mangkonkontra iti legalisasion iti panagkasar ti agpada a sekso.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Nagdedebateanda iti 10 a tawen iti National Congress ti Brazil ti legalisasion, ket legal laeng dagita a panagkasar a sibil iti agdama iti Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Iti orihinal a gakat a linteg ket insurat ti dati a mayor ti São Paolo a ni Marta Suplicy. Ti naisingasing a lehislasion, kalpasan a naamendaran, ket adda itan kadagiti ima ni Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Mangnamnama dagiti agproprotesta a makakolektada iti petision a 1.2 a milion a pirma tapno ipresentada iti National Congress inton Nobiembre.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Malpas a nalawag nga adu ti pamilia nga agbirbirok ti legal a tulong tapno malabanan ti pannakapaksiatda, maysa a gimong ti napasamak idi Marso 20 idiay East Bay Community Law Center para kadagiti biktima ti inaallilaw a panangbalay.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Idi mangrugi nga ibaga dagiti agin-indeg ti napasamak kadakuada, kaaduan kadagiti nairaman a pamilia ti dagus a nakaamiris a tinakaw ni Carolyn Wilson ti OHA dagiti security deposits-da, ken naglibasen daytoy.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Dagiti agab-abang idiay Lockwood Gardens ket mamati a mabalin nga adda pay ti sabali a 40 a pamilia wenno ad-adu a mabalin a mapaksiat, manipud idi naamuanda a dagiti polis iti OHA ket mangim-imbestigar ti dadduma pay a sanikua a pagbalayan idiay Oakland ket mabalin a madakamat idiay pananglokloko bayat iti panagbalay.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Naibalud dagiti nalatak nga abogado a Griego a da Sakis Kechagioglou ken George Nikolakopoulos iti pagbaludan ti Korydallus iti Athens, ta naduktalan a nagbasolda iti panagkunniber ken korupsion.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Kas resultana daytoy, ti dakkel nga eskandalo ti uneg ti legal a komunidad ti Griego ket nairuar gapu ti pannakaipakita dagiti ilegal nga ar-aramid dagiti ukom, abogado, solisitor ken dagiti abogado ket nagaramid ti napalabas a tawen.
eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Mano a lawas ti napalabas, kalpasan nga iti impormasion ket nairuar ti journalista a ni Makis Triantafylopoulos ti pabuyana ti Telebision a “Zoungla” ti Alpha TV, ti miembro ti Parliamento ken abogado,na ni Petros Mantouvalos ket napababa ti puesto bayat ti pannakairamraman dagiti miembro ti opisinana ti ilegal nga ar-aramid ken korupsion.
eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Nayonna pay, ti kangatuan a hukom a ni Evangelos Kalousis ket naibalud gapu ti pannakaartapna nga agbasol ti korapsion ken madi nga aramid.
eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Nagkedked ni Roberts a mangibaga iti maipapan iti patienna no kaano a mangrugi ti biag, maysa a napateg a saludsod no panunoten iti etika ti aborsion, nga imbagana a saan nga etikal ti agkomento maipapan kadagiti detalye ti kakastoy a kaso.
eng_text: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Inaramidna, ngem, inulitna nga imbagana a ni Roe v. Wade ket isu ti “nagnaed a linteg ti daga”, maipaganetget ti kapatgan ti agpapada a paglintegan ti Korte Suprema.
eng_text: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Pinatalgedanna pay a mamati isuna iti naipaduyakyak a karbengan iti kinapribado nga isu ti nakaibatayan ti desision a Roe.
eng_text: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

eng_text: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Nadengngeg ti kaso idiay Virginia nga isu iti nagtaengan ti nalatak a mangmangted iti serbisio iti internet nga AOL, ti kompania a nangtignay dagiti reklamo.
eng_text: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Daytoy ti umuna a gundaway a nagun-od ti maysa a pannakaikeddeng a mausar ti lehislasion a napagbalin a linteg idi 2003 tapno malapdan ti naipadu nga email, wenno am-ammo a kas spam, manipud iti di dawdawaten a pannakaiwaras iti mailbox dagiti agus-usar.
eng_text: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text: Idi Enero itay napan a tawen 2017, ti 21-anyos a ni Jesus ket nakikadua iti Manchester City manipud iti Palmeiras a club iti Brazil iti naireport a bayad a £27 a milion.
eng_text: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Manipud idin, naiparang ti Brazilian iti 53 a laban para iti club iti amin a kompetision ket nakapuntos isuna iti 24 a goal.
eng_text: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: Impakaammo met ni Dr. Lee ti pannakaseknanna maipapan kadagiti report a dagiti ubbing idiay Turkia itan ket naakaran iti A(H1N1) avian influenza virus a saanda met a nagsaksakit.
eng_text: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: Ti dadduma a panangadal ibagada nga iti sakit ket agbalin a saan a makapapatay sakbay a makagapu daytoy iti sangalubongan nga epidemya, isu ti kunana.
eng_text: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: Adda pakaseknan a dagiti pasiente ket amangan no agtultuloyda a makaakar iti ad-adu pay a tattao babaen iti inaldaw-aldaw nga ar-aramidda no dagiti sintomas ti trangkaso ket agtalinaed a saan a nakaro.
eng_text: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Imbaga ni Leslie Aun, panakangiwat para ti Komen Foundation, a nangaramid iti organisasion iti baro a linteg a saan a mangpalubos iti panagtustos wenno panagpondo kadagiti organisasion a maim-imbestigaran.
eng_text: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Diniskalipika ti annuroten ti Komen ti Planned Parenthood gapu iti maur-uray nga imbestigasion nga isaysayangkat ni Representante Cliff Stearns no kasano ti panaggastos ken ti panagireport iti kuarta ti Planned Parenthood.
eng_text: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Madama ti panagimbestigar ni Stearns no dagiti buis ket maus-usar a pangpondo kadagiti aborsion babaen ti Planned Parenthood gapu ta isu ti tserman ti Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, nga idadauluan ti House Energy and Commerce Committee.
eng_text: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Diay dati a gobernador ti Massachusetts Mitt Romney ket nangabak iti immuna a presidensial nga eleksion iti Partido Republikano iti Florida idi Martes nga addaan iti surok 46 porsiento dagiti butos.
eng_text: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: Diay dati nga U. S Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich ket maikadua nga addaan iti 32 porsiento.
eng_text: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Kas estado nga alan-amin-iti-mangabak, inted ti Florida iti amin a limapulo a delegadona kenni Romney, a nangiduron kaniada iti un-unna kas front-runner para iti nominasion iti Partido Republika.
eng_text: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Imbaga dagiti nangidaulo iti protesta a dumanon iti 100,000 a tattao ti nagparang kadagiti siudad iti Germany kas iti Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, ken Hanover.
eng_text: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: Idiay Berlin, pinattapatta  dagiti polis ti 6,500 nga agprotprotesta.
eng_text: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Napasamak met dagiti protesta idiay Paris, Sofica iti Bulgaria, Vilnius iti Lithuania, Valetta iti Malta, Tallinn iti Estonia, ken Edinburgh ken Glasgow iti Scotland.
eng_text: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: Idiay London, agarup 200 a tattao ti nagprotesta iti ruar ti sumagmamano nga opisina dagiti dadakkel a kompania nga agtagikua iti copyright.
eng_text: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Idi naminsan a bulan, adu ti nangruna a protesta idiay Poland no kaano a ti pagilian ket nagpirma iti ACTA, a nangiturong iti gobierno ti Poland nga agdesision a saanda pay a pasingkedan dayta a katulagan, tatta.
eng_text: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Iti Latvia ken Slovakia ket agpada a naudi iti prosesona a pannakikuyog iti ACTA.
eng_text: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Ti Animal Liberation ken ti Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) kidkiddawenda manen ti inkapilitan a pannakaikabit dagiti CCTV kamera iti amin a pagpartian iti Australia.
eng_text: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Inbaga ni David O'Shannessy hepe nga inspektor iti RSPCA New South Wales iti ABC nga iti pannakakita ken inspeksion dagiti pagpartian ket masapul a sangapada iti Australia.
eng_text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: “Sigurado a mangted iti ballaag ti CCTV kadagiti tattao nga agob-obra kadagiti pagtaraknan iti ayup a ti pagsayaatan dagiti ayup ti kangatuan a maipangruna.”
eng_text: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Impakita ti mapa iti ginggined iti lubong diay Geological Survey iti Estados Unidos nga awan iti gingined idiay Iceland idi napalabas a lawas.
eng_text: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Inpadamag met ti Meteorolohikal nga Opisina ti Icelandic nga awan iti aktibidad ti gingined iti paset ti Hekla iti nalpas nga 48 nga oras.
eng_text: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Ti kangrunaan nga aktibidad ti gingined a nagresulta iti panagbaliw iti saad a napasamak idi Marso 10 idiay amianan a daya iti sikig ti wangawangan iti tuktok ti bulkan.
eng_text: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Naireport dagiti nangisit nga ulep a saan a gapu ti aktibidad iti bulkan iti baba ti bantay.
eng_text: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Dagiti ulap ket nangited iti posible a panagriribuk no adda talaga ti napasamak a panagputok iti bulkan.
eng_text: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Ti Luno ket naglaon iti 120–160 metro kubiko a krudo idi naperdi ken dagiti nangato nga angin ken dalluyon ti nangiduron kadagitoy iti taaw.
eng_text: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Insalakan dagiti helikopter dagiti sangapulo-ket-dua a miembro ti crew ket ti laeng dunor ket naparpar nga agong.
eng_text: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Daytoy 100 a metro a barko ket mapan nangala iti gagangay a kargana a ganagan ket idi umuna mabuteng dagiti opisial a baka maibelleng iti barko dagiti kargana.
eng_text: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Pimmasa iti agpada a kamara ti naisingasing a panangamienda idi 2011.
eng_text: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Maysa a panangbaliw ti naaramid iti daytoy a sesion a lehislatibo idi a ti maikadua a sentensia ket inikkat nga immuna ti Kamara ti Representante sa impasa ti Senado idi Lunes ti isu met laeng nga umasping a porma.
eng_text: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Iti pannakapaay ti maikadua a sentensia, a mangisingsingasing iti pannakaiparit ti sibil a panagtipon dagiti agpada ti seksona, ket mabalin a luktanna ti ruangan para kadagiti sibil a panagtipon iti masakbayan.
eng_text: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: No suroten ti proseso, ti HJR-3 ket repasuento manen ti sumaruno a nabutosan a lehislatura a nalabit inton 2015 wenno 2016 tapno agtultuloy ti proseso.
eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Dagiti nagapuanan ni Vautier iti ruar iti panagdirekta ket mairaman dayta saanna a pannagna idi 1973 laban iti makunana a panangsensor a politikal.
eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Nagbaliw ti linteg a French. Nagsubli ti aktibismona iti edad a 15 idi kimmappeng iti French Resistance kabayatan ti Maikadua a Gubat Sangalubongan.
eng_text: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Insuratna ti maipapan ti biagna iti 1998 a libro.
eng_text: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Idi 1960, nagsubli isuna iti nabiit pay a nagwaywayas nga Algeria tapno agisuro iti panagiturong iti pelikula.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Ti Hapon a judoka a ni Hitoshi Saito, nangabak iti dua a balitok a medalia iti Olympic, ket natay ti tawen a 54.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Ti gapu ti pannakatayna ket naipakaammo a kanser iti intrahepatic bile duct.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Natay isuna idiay Osaka idi Martes.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Kasta pay ti panangbalinna a dati a kampeon ti Olympic ken Lubong, ni Saito ti nangidaulo ti komite ti panagsanay ti Pederasion ti Judo ti Amin a Japan iti oras ti papatay na.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Saan a bumaba iti 100 a tattao ti immatendar iti ragragsak, tapno rambakan ti umuna nga anibersario iti agasawa a nagkasar idi naudi a tawen.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Naituding ti pormal a pannakaangay ti anibersario iti nabaybayag a petsa, kinuna dagiti opisial.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Nagpakasar manen ti agpares idiay Texas maysa tawen ti napalabas ken napan idiay Buffalo tapno makipagragsak a kadua dagiti gagayyem ken kakabagian.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Ti 30-tawen nga asawa a lalaki, a naiyanak idiay Buffalo, ket maysa kadagiti uppat a natay iti pannakapaltog, ngem iti asawana ket saan a nadangran.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Ni Karno ket mapadpadayawan ngem kontrobersial a mangisursuro iti Ingles a nangisuro iti uneg ti Moderno nga Edukasion ken king's Glory a maibagbaga nga addaan iti 9,000 nga estudyante iti kangato ti karerana.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Iti suratna inusarna dagiti balikas nga ipagarup dagiti dadduma a nagannak a nakersang, ken maatap nga agus-usar isuna iti dakes a sao iti klase.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Pinabasol ti Moderno nga Edukasion isuna iti panagimprenta iti dadakkel nga anunsio kadagiti bus nga awanan pammalubos ken panagulbod iti pannangibagana nga isuna ti hepe a mangisuro iti Ingles.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Naakusaran met isuna idi ti copyright infringement, ngem saan a naidarum.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Kinuna ti dati nga estudiante nga isuna ket “nagusar iti slang iti klase, nagisuro iti kinalaing iti innarem, ken kasla gayyem isuna dagiti estudiante.”
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Bayat iti naudi a tallo a dekada, uray no opisial a nagtalinaed nga estado a komunista, ti Tsina ket nakabukel iti nawaya a merkado ti ekonomia.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Ti umuna nga ekonomiko a reporma ket naaramid iti panangidaulo ni Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Nangrugi idin, ti kadakkel ti ekonomia ti China ket dimakkel iti 90 nga ulit.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Ti umuna a beses, idi naudi a tawen nag-export ti Tsina iti ad-adu a kotse ngem iti Alemania ken naunaanna ti Estados Unidos kas kadakkelan a merkado kadagitoy nga industriya.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Ti GDP ti Tsina ket mabalin dakdakketonl ngem iti Estados Unidos iti uneg ti dua a dekada.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Iti tropikal a bagyo a ni Danielle, maikauppat a nagan iti panawen ti bagyo idiay Atlantiko para iti 2010, ket nabuo idiay makindaya a Baybay Atlantiko.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Ti bagyo, a masarakan iti agarup 3,000 a milia manipud iti Miami, Florida, ket addaan iti kapigsaan nga angin a 40mph (64 kph).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Impakauna dagiti sientista iti National Hurricane Center a pumigsa ni Danielle a kas bagyo inton Mierkoles.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Agsipud ta adayo pay a sumanglad ti bagyo, agtalinaed a narigat a maibaga ti mabalin nga epektona iti Estados Unidos wenno iti Caribbean.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Naiyanak idiay Zagreb a kapitolio ti Croatia, naglatak ni Bobek bayat nga agay-ay-ayam para iti Partizan Belgrade.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Kinaduana ida idi 1945 ken nagbati inggana 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Idi panawenna kadua ti grupo, naka-iskor isuna iti 403 a goal iti 468 a panagpakitana.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Awanen ti nakaaramid iti ad-adu a pannakaparang wenno nakaaramid iti adu a puntos para iti klab no saan a ni Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Idi 1995 nabutosan isuna a kalalaingan nga agay-ayam iti pakasaritaan ti Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Ti selebrasion ket nangrugi iti espesial a pabuya ti mapadpadayawan a sangalubongan a grupo a ti Cirque du Soleil.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Simmaruno iti daytoy ti Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, maysaga banda a Janissary, ken dagiti kumakanta a da Fatih Erkoç ken Müslum Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Ket, napan ti Whirling Dervishes idiay entablado.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Ti Turkish a diva a ni Sezen Aksu ket nagpabuya a kaduana ti tenor nga Italiano a ni Alesssandro Safina ken ti kumakanta a Griego a ni Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Ti panangleppas, ti Turkish a grupo dagiti agsasala ket nangipabuya ti mabuya a “Troy”.
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Ni Peter Lenz, maysa nga 13 a tawen a karerista iti motorsiklo, ket natay kalpasan a nairaman iti panagdinnungpar idiay Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Bayat nga adda idiay warm-up lap, natumba ni Lenz manipud iti bisikletana, ket napilidan ti kaduana nga agkarkarera a ni Xavier Zayat.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Dagus nga inasikado isuna dagiti sumursurot a kameng ti medikal sa naitaray iti lokal nga ospital a nakatayannan.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Saan a napasakitan ni Zayat idiay aksidente.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Maipapan iti pangglobo a pinansial a situasion, intuloy ni Zapatero babaen ti panangibaga a “ti sistema a pinansial ket parte ti ekonomia, maysa a napateg a parte.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Adda ti makatawen a krisis iti pinansialtayo, a addaan iti kinapalalona iti napalabas a dua a bulan, ket maikunak a dagiti pinansial a merkado ket mangrugin a makaungar.”
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Idi napalabas a lawas, inwaragawag ti Naked News a nayonanda dagiti usarda nga internasional a lengguahe para iti panagireport iti damdamag, para iti tallo a kabarbaro a broadcast.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Madama nga agrep-report iti English ken Japanese, ti sangalubungan nga organisasion ken mangiruar iti Spanish, Italian, ken Korean a palabas, para iti telebision, iti web, ken alikamen a mobile.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: naimbag ta awan napasamak kaniak, ngem nakakitaak iti macabre, dagiti tao ket pinerdida dagiti tawa tapno laeng makarwarda.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Targetda dagiti tattao ti tugaw dagiti sarming ti tawa, ngem saan a madadael dagiti tawa.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Maysa kadagiti sarming ti nadadael, ket nangrugida a rummuar iti tawa,” kinuna ti nakalasat a ni Franciszek Kowal.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Dagiti bituen ket mangted iti sillag ken pudot gapu iti enerhia a naaramid no dagiti hydrogen atomo ket agtipon (wenno agkaykaysada) nga agkadwa tapno makabuo iti nadagdagsen nga elemento.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Agtrabaho dagiti sientipiko tapno makaaramidda iti reaktor a makaaramid iti enerhia iti pada a pamay-an.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Ngem daytoy ket maysa a problema a narigat masolbar ket kasapulan iti adu a tawen sakbay a makakitatayo a maaramid iti mausaren a reaktor para iti fusion.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Agtapaw ti asero a dagum iti rabaw ti danum gapu iti surface tension.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Ti tension iti rabaw ket mapaspasamak gapu ta dagiti molecule iti danum ket napigsa ti atraksionda iti maysa ken maysa ngem iti atraksionda kadagiti molecule ti angin iti ngatoda.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Dagiti molekula ti danum ket mangaramid ti saan a makita a lalat idiay rabaw iti danum a mangpalubos kadagiti bambanag a kas ti dagum a tumpaw iti rabaw iti danum.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Ti blade ti moderno nga ice skate ket dua ti tadenma sa adda espasio iti nagbaetan dagiti tadem . Gapu iti dua a tadem, nalaklaka a kumpet ti blade iti yelo, uray no agirig.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Gapu ta iti baba ti tadem ket apagapaman a nagkurba, agirig ti tadem iti maysa a bangir wenno iti sabali a bangir, agkurba met ti ikingna a maitama iti yelo.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Isu ti gapuna daytoy nga agturong dagiti skater. No dagiti skate ket agsikig iti kannawan, ti skater ket agpakannawan, no iti skate ket agsikig iti kannigid, ti skater ket agpakannigid.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Tapno makasubli iti dati a nibel ti enerhiada, masapul nga ikkatenda ti surok ti enerhia a naalada manipud iti lawag.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ar-aramidenda daytoy bayat ti panangiruar iti bassit a partikulo ti lawag a maaw-awagan a “photon”.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Awagan dagiti sientista daytoy a proseso a “natignay a panagruar ti radiasion” gapu ta dagiti atomo ket natignay bayat ti nalawag a silaw, paggapuan ti iruruar ti photon iti silaw, ken ti silaw ket maysa a wagas ti radiasion.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Ti sumaruno a ladawan ket ipakitana dagiti atomo nga agpatpataud ti photons. Siempre, ti kinapudnona dagiti photons ket basbassit ngem kadagiti makita iti ladawan.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Basbassit pay dagiti photon ngem kadagiti banag a mangbukel kadagiti atomo!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Kalpasan ti ginasut nga oras ti operasion ti linabag ti bombilia, agangay a mapuoran ket saanen nga agbalin ti silaw a bombilia.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Masapul a masuktanen ti bombilia. Nasisita nga aganannad iti panagsukat ti bombilia.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Masapul a ti switch ti bombilia ket maiddep nga umuna, wenno maisina ti kablena.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Maigapu daytoy a ti koriente a magmagna mapan iti sulbonganna no sadino ti ayan ti metal a parte a nakapuestuan ti bombilia ket makaited kenka iti nakaro a pannakakoriente no iggamam dayta makin-uneg a parte iti nagsulbongan wenno dayta metal a nakaimontaran dayta bumbilya bayat nga adda pay isuna idiay nagsulbungan.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Ti kangrunaan nga organo ti sistema ti panagbalikuskos ket ti puso, nga isu ti mangibomba iti dara.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ti dara ket pumanaw aggapo iti puso idiay tubo a maawagan nga arteries ken agsubli iti puso manipud iti tubo a maawagan a veins. Ti sangkabassitan a tubo ket maawagan a capillaries.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Ti ngipen ti triceratop ket mabalin a makabael a mangparpar saan laeng a bulong no di ket uray dagiti natangken a sanga ken ramot.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Panunoten dagiti dadduma a sientipiko a ti Triceratops ket mangmangan ti cycad, a maysa a klase iti mula a gagangayen idi panawen ti Cretaceous.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Dagitoy a mulmula ket aglanglanga a kas bassit a niog nga adda ti koronana a natadem, ken natatarid a bulbulong.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Mabalin nga inusar ti Triceratops ti napigsa a sippitna tapno ikkaten dagiti bulbulong sakbayna a kanen ti sanga.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Ipapilit dagiti dadduma a sientipiko a dagitoy a mulmula ket permi a makapasabidong isu a posible a saan a kinnan daytoy dagiti dinosaur, uray no itatta a panawen ti sloth ken sabali pay nga animal kaspagarigan ti parrot (a kaputotan dagiti dinosaur) ket kayada ti mangan ti makapasabidong a bulbulong wenno prutprutas.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ania ti epekto ti grabidad ti Io kaniak? No tumakderka iti rabaw ti Io, nalaglag-anka ngem no addaka iti Daga.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ti tao nga addaan kadagsen a 200 a libra (90kg) iti Daga ket agdagsen ti agarup 36 a libra (16kg) idiay Io. Isu a ti gravity, siempre, ket basbassit ti guyodna kenka.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Awan ti crust ti Init a kas ti Daga a mabalinmo a pagtakderan. Naaramid ti sibubukel nga Init iti angin, apuy, ken plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Uming-ingpis ti gas bayat nga umad-adayoka manipud iti sentro ti Init.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Ti akinruar a parte a makitatayo no kumitatayo iti Init ket maawagan iti photosphere, a kayatna a sawen ket “bola ti lawag”.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Agarup tallo ribu a tawenen ti napalabas, idi 1610, iti Italiano nga astronomer a ni Galileo Galilei ket nagusar ti teleskopio tapno makitana nga adda paset iti Venus, a kas adda met iti bulan.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Dagiti dadduma a langa ket mapaspasamak gapu ta ti laeng igid iti Venus (wenno iti Bulan) a nakasango iti Init ti masillagan. Dagiti langlanga ti Venus ket suportaranna ti teoria ni Copernicus a dagiti planeta ket aglikaw iti Init.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Kalpasanna, sumagmamano a tawen ti napalabas idi 1639, maysa nga astronomo nga Ingles nga agnagan iti Jeremiah Horrocks ti nakapaliiw iti ilalabas ti Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Napadasan iti Inglatera ti atiddog a panawen ti kinatalna malpas ti panangparmek manen iti Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ngem idi 991 ti Ethelred nakasangona iti adu a barko a Viking a dakdakkel pay ngem aniaman manipud pay idi panawen ti Guthrum maysa a siglo ti napalabas.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Daytoy a bunggoy ket indauluan ni Olaf Trygvasson, maysa a Norwegian nga adda ambisionna a mabawi iti nasion nga aggapu iti panagturay dagiti Danish.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Malpas dagiti umuna a problema ti militar, nakitinnulag ni Ethelred kadagiti termino ni Olaf, a nagsubli idiay Norway tapno padasenna a bawien iti pagarian nga addaan aglalauk a panagballigi.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Ti Hangeul laeng iti naimbento a alpabeto a nalatak a maus-usar inaldaw. Naimbento ti alpabeto idi 1444 idi panagturay ni Ari Sejong (1418 − 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Ni Ari Sejong ti maikauppat nga ari iti Dinastia ti Joseon ken maysa kadagiti addaan nangato a panangraem.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Tii orihinal nga impanagannana iti alpabeto a Hangeul ket Hunmin Jeongeum, a kayatna a sawen ket “ti husto nga uni para iti panangsursuro kadagiti tattao”.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Nagadu ti teoria no apay a nabukel ti Sanskrit. Maysa kadagitoy ket maipanggep iti panagakar ti Aryan a naggapu iti laud mapan idiay India a nangitugot ti pagsasaoda kadakuada.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Ti Sanskrit ket maysa a daan a pagsasao ken maikumpara ti pagsasao ti Latin idiay Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Ti kasasapaan a naammuan a libro iti lubong ket naisurat iti Sanskrit. Kalpasan a naurnong dagiti Upanishad, nagawan lattaniti Sanskrit gapu iti hirarkia.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Ti Sanskrit ket kumplikado ken nabaknang a pagsasao, nga isu ti agserserbi a naggapuanan ti adu a moderno a pagsasao ti Indiano, kasla ti Latin a naggapuan dagiti pagsasao idiay Europa a kas iti French ken Espaniol.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Idin ta nalpasen ti gubat para iti Francia, nangrugin nga agsagana ti Alemania a mangraut iti isla ti Britania.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Inikkan ti Germany iti code name ti panagatake nga “Operation Sealion”. Kaaduan kadagiti nadadagsen nga armas ken abasto ti British Army ti napukaw idi immakarda manipud iti Dunkirk, isu a napakapsutan ti army.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ngem ti Royal Navy ket agtalinaed a napigpigsa latta ngem iti German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) ken mabalinna a nadadael koma ti aniaman nga rumaot nga adu a barko a maipatulod iti English Channel.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Nupay kasta, bassit laeng a bilang dagiti barko ti Royal Navy ti nakabase iti asideg dagiti mabalin a ruta ti iraraut gapu ta mabuteng dagiti admiral a palneden ida ti panangatake dagiti eroplano dagit Aleman.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Rugiantayo babaen iti panangilawlawag kadagiti plano ti Italia. Kangrunaanna, ti Italia ti “ading” ti Germany ken Japan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Addaan daytoy iti nakapkapuy nga army ken nakapkapuy a navy, nupay kalkalpasda laeng ti nagaramid iti uppat a baro a barko sakbay ti mismo a rugi ti gubat.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Ti kangrunaan a kayat ti Italia ket dagiti pagilian idiay Africa. Tapno makemmeg dagitoy a pagilian, masapulda ti pangipatayaban ti buyotda, isu a dagitoy a buyot ket aglayagda a lumasat ti Taaw ti Mediterranean ken parmekenda ti Africa.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Para ti dayta, masapol da ikkaten dagiti base iti British ken dagiti barko idiay Ehipto. Pwera kadagita a garaw, dagiti barko a panglaban ti Italya ket awan iti sabali anga masapolna aramidenen.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Ita met ti Japan. Maysa nga isla a pagilian ti Japan, a kas iti Britania.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Dagiti submarino ket barkona naidisenyo nga agbiahe iti uneg iti baybay, ken agtalinaed idiay iti nawayway a gatad ti oras.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Nausar dagiti submarino iti Umuna a Gubat Sangalubongan ken Maikadua a Gubat Sangalubongan. Idi a panawen, nakabumbuntog dagitoy ken limitado la ti kaadayo ti madanon ti iputokda.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Idi rugrugi ti giyera napanda idiay ngato iti baybay, ngem idi mabuo ti radar ken agbalbalinen a husto dagiti sabmarin ket napuersa a mapan iti uneg ti danum tapno saanda a makita.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Dagiti submarino ti Alemania ket naawagan nga U-Boats. Nalaing unay dagiti Aleman a mangmaneho ken ag-opera kadagitoy a submarino.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Gapu iti balligida kadagiti submarino, saanen a mapagtalkan dagiti German a maaddaan iti adu kadagitoy.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Wen! Ni Ari a Tutankhamun, no maminsan ket maawagan a kas “Ari a Tut” wenno “Iti Ubing a Ari”, ket maysa kadagiti nalatak a kadaanan nga ari ti Ehipto iti moderno a panawen.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Ti makapainteres, saan isuna a maibilang nga importante idi agkakauna a panawen ken saan a naisurat isuna kadagiti kadaanan a listaan ti ari.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nupay kasta, nagbalin isuna a nalatak gapu iti pannakadiskobre iti tanemna idi 1922. Idinto nga adu a tanem ti nataktakawan iti naglabas,  agarup saan a pulos a nasingsinga daytoy a tanem.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Naipreserba a nalaiang ti kaaduan kadagiti bambanag a naikali a kadua ni Tutankhamun, pakairamanan ti rinibribu nga artefact a naaramid iti napapateg a metal ken manmano a batbato.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ti pannakaimbento ti nagrayos a pilid a nangaramid a dagiti karuahe iti Assyria a nalaglag-an, naparpartak, ken nasaysayaat a sisasagana a rangbawan dagiti suldado ken dadduma a karuahe.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Makapapatay dagiti panada ta masalputda dagiti kabal dagiti kalabanda a soldado. Idi 1000 B. C., dagiti Asiriano ti damo a nangiyussuat iti panagsakay iti kabalio bayat ti pannakigubat.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Ti cavalry ket dagiti mannakigubat a nakakabalio a makilaban. Saan pay idi a naimbento ti pagtugawan iti likud ti kabalio, isu a nakilaban ti cavalry ti Assyrian a nakatugawda iti labus a bukot dagiti kabalioda.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Adu ti ammotayo a Griego a politiko, mamasirib ti siyensaa ken artista. Mabalin a ti kalalatakan kadagitoy a kultura ket ni Homer, ti legendario a bulsek a mannaniw, a nangaramid ti dua nga obra maestra ti literatura ti Griego: ti daniw a Iliad ken Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Nalatak latta a mannuratda Sophocles ken Aristophanes ket dagiti play da ket maibilang a maysa kadagiti kadadakkelan nga aramid ti lubong iti literatura.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Maysa pay a mapadpadayawan nga Griego a matematiko ni Pythagoras, mabigbigbig para iti sikat a theorem a panggep ti relasion dagiti igid ti trianggulo.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Adda dagiti nadumaduma a panangpattapatta no kasano kaadu dagiti tattao nga agsasao iti Hindi. Napattapatta nga adda iti nagbaetan ti maikadua ken maikapat a kaaaduan a gagangay a maisasao a lengguahe iti lubong.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Ti bilang dagiti katutubo ket mabalin nga agbaliw depende no maibilang dagiti daddumapay nga agiinnasideg a dialekto.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Dagiti pattapata ket manipud 340 milion aginggana 500 milion nga agsarsarita, ket agarup 800 a milion a tattao ti makaawat ti panagsarsarita.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Agpada ti bokabulario ti Hindi ken Urdu ngem agdumada iti pannakaisurat;  no agtungtong dagiti agsasao kadagitoy a pagsasao, gagangay nga agkinnaawatanda.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Idi maika-15 a siglo, ti makin-amianan nga Estonia ket adda ti sirok iti dakkel a kultural nga impluwensia ti Alemania.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Kalikagum dagiti dadduma a monghe a German a mayasideg ti Dios kadagiti natibo a tao, isu nga inimbentoda ti literal a pagsasao nga Estonian.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Naibasar daytoy ti alpabeto ti German ket nanayunan ti maysa a letra “Õ/õ”.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Iti panaglabas ti panawen, adu a sao ti binulod naggapu iti German ti nagtitipon. Isu daytoy ti rugi ti pakalawlawagan.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Kas kadawyan, ti agtawid iti trono ket mapan a diretso iti militar no malpasnan ti ageskuela.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Ngem, napan ni Charles iti unibersidad idiay Trinity College, Cambridge no sadino a pinagadalan ti Antropolohia ken Arkeolohia, ken idi kamaudianna, Pakasaritaan, agurnong ti 2:2 (maysa a nababbaba a maikadua a klase a tukad).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Ni Charles ti umuna a miembro ti Royal a Pamilia a Briton a nakaawat iti digri.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Ti Turkey ti Europa (makindaya a Thrase wenno Rumelia idiay peninsula iti Balkan) ket iramanna ti 3% iti nasion.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Ti teritoryo ti Turkey ket nasurok a 1,600 kilometro (1,000 milya) kaatiddog ken 800 km (500 mi) kaakaba, a kuadrado ti pormana.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Ti kalawa ti Turkey, kadua dagiti danaw, agnanaed iti 783,562 kuadrado a kilometro (300,948 sq mi), nga iti 755,688 kuadrado a kilometro (291,773 sq mi) ket adda idiay abagatan a laud ti Asya ket 23,764 kuadrado a kilometro (9,174 sq mi) ket adda idiay Europe.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Ti kalawa ti Turkey ti namagbalin iti daytoy a maika-37 a kadakkelan a pagilian iti sangalubongan, ken agarup kas kalawa ti napagtipon a Metropolitan France ken United Kingdom.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Ti Turkey ket napalawlawan ti baybay iti tallo nga igidna: Ti BayBay Aegean idiay laud, ti Nangisit a Baybay idiay amianan, ken ti Baybay Mediteranio idiay abagatan.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Adda atiddog apakasaritaan ti Luxembourg ngem ti independensiana ket idi pay 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Dagiti agdama a parte ti Belgium ket parte ti Luxembourg idi un-unana ngem nagbalin a parte ti Belgium kalpasan ti rebolusion idiay Belgium idi 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Kanayon a padpadasen ti Luxembourg nga agtalinaed a neutral a pagilian ngem naparmek isuna ti Germany iti agpada a Gubat Sangalubungan I ken Gubat Sangalubungan II.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Idi 1957 ket nagbalin ti Luxembourg nga immuna a kameng ti buyot a nalatak tatta a kas European Union.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Ti Drukgyal Dzong ket nadadael a baluarte ken monasterio ti Budista idiay makinngato a paset iti Distrito ti Paro (idiay Purok ti Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Kunada nga idi 1649, ni Zhabdrung Ngawag Namgyel ket nangaramid ti baluarte tapno malagip ti pannakaparmek ti puersa ti Tibetan-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Idi 1951, maysa nga uram ti nangigapu a dadduma laeng kadagiti reliko iti Drukgyal Dzong ti naibati, kas ti imahe ni Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Kalpasan ti uram, napreserba ken naprotektaran ti kuta, ket nagtalinaed a maysa kadagiti kapipintasan nga atraksion iti Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Kabayatan ti maika-18 a siglo, naipasngat ti Cambodia iti nagbaaetan ti dua a nabileg a kaarrubana, ti Thailand ken ti Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Niraut dagiti Thai ti Cambodia iti mano nga ulit idi ika-18 a siglo ken idi 1722 dinadaelda ti Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Idi maudi a taw-tawen ti maika-18 a siglo, dagiti taga-Vietnam nirautda met ti Cambodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Sangapulo-ket-walo a porsiento dagiti taga-Venezuela ti awanan iti trabaho, ken kaaduan kadagiti addaan iti trabaho ti agob-obra iti impormal nga ekonomia.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dua a kakatlo kadagiti Venezuelan nga agob-obra ti adda iti sektor ti serbisio, dandani kakapat ti agob-obra iti industria ken kalima ti agob-obra iti agrikultura
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Langis ti kangrunaan nga industria ti Venezuela, a no sadino a ti pagilian ket agilaklako iti sabali a pagilian , uray no maysa a porsiento laeng ti agob-obra iti industria ti langis.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Idi rugrugi ti pannakawayawaya ti pagilian, dagiti eksperto iti Botanic Gardens iti Singapore ket timmulongda iti panagbalin ti isla kas tropikal a Garden City.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Idi 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, maysa nga adda laokna nga orkidia, ket napili kas nasional a sabong iti pagilian.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Kada tawen iti bulan ti Oktubre, dandani 1.5 milion nga agar-arab nga animal manipud iti kabambantayan iti amianan ti mapan iti kapanagan iti abagatan, a ballasiwenda ti Karayan Mara, tapno addada sadiay bayat ti panagtutudo.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Ken agsubli idiay amianan mapan laud, bumallasiw manen iti karayan Mara, malpas ti tudo banda iti Abril.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Lalaonen iti rehion ti Serengeti iti Nasional a Parke ti Serengeti, iti Lugar ti Konserbasion ti Ngorongoro ken iti Reserba ti Ay-ayam ti Maswa idiay Tanzania ken iti Nasional nga Reserba iti Maasai Mara idiay Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Ti panagsursuro nga agaramid ti interaktibo a media ket kasapulanna ti kombensional ken tradisional a paglaingan, ken dagiti alikamen a nakabisado ti pagadalan nga interaktibo (panag-storyboard, panag-edit ti audio ken video, panagistorya, ken dadduma).
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Kasapulan iti panagdisenio nga interaktibo nga amirisem manen dagiti panangipagarupmo maipapan iti media production ken sursuruem ti agpanunot iti non-linear nga wagas.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Makasapul ti interaktibo a disenio kadagiti paset ti maysa a proyekto a konektado iti maysa ken maysa, ngem masapul a makabael met iti bukbukodna.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Ti saan a pagsayaatan ti lente ti zoom ket ti kumplikado a pokusna ken ti kinaadu ti elemento iti lentena a kasapulan tapno maala ti sakup ti kinaatiddog ti pokus ket ad-adu ngem para kadagiti primo a lente.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Saanen a dakkel nga isyu daytoy ta talaga a sumaysayaaten ti pannakaaramid dagiti lens.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Impalubos daytoy a makaparnuay dagiti lente a pangpaadayo kadagiti litrato a dekalidad kompara kadagidiay maala kadagiti lente nga addaan di makuti a kaadayo ti pokusna.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Maysa a pakadillawan dagiti lente a mangpaadayo ket masansan a nababbaba ti kadadakkelan nga aperture wenno pagserkan ti lawag (kapegges) iti lente.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Daytoy ti makagapu a narigat nga usaren dagiti lalakaen a lente iti saan unay a nalawag no saanka nga agusar ti flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Maysa kadagiti gagangay a parikot bayatiti panangipadas a mangi-convert iti pelikula ti format ti DVD ket iti overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Kaaduan a telebision ket naaramid tapno maliwliwa ti publiko.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Gapu iti dayta, amin a makitam iti TV ket naputol iti ngato, baba, ken iti dua a sikiganna.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Naaramid daytoy tapno masigurado a maakkuban ti imahen ti sibubukel nga screen. Maaw-awagan daytoy iti overscan.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Nakaliliday, no agaramidka iti DVD, dagiti igidna ket mabalin a maputedmet, ken no ti video ket adda met ti subtitulona nga asideg iti baba, saan a makita a buo dagitoy.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Nabayagen a mangipapaay iti inspirasion iti imahinasion ti tradisional a mediebal a kastilio, a mangisubli kadagiti ladawan dagiti panagdadangadang, bangkete ken dayaw nga Arthurian.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Uray pay ti panagtakder bayat iti rinibu a tawen a nadadael ket nalaka a panunuten dagiti ringgor ken uni dagiti nalpas a gubgubat, a dumani a mangngegan dagiti baddek dagiti kabalio ken maangot ti buteng a tumpaw kadagiti pagbaludan.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ngem naibasar kadi ti imahinasiontayo iti realidad? Apay a naaramid dagiti kastilio? Kasanoda a nadisenio ken naaramid?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Kas gagangay idi a panawen, ti Kastilo ti Kirby Muxloe ket ad-adda a nausar kas nasarikedkedan a balay imbes a kas agpaypayso a kastilo.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Dagiti dadakkel a nasileng a tawa ken naiingpis a paderna, saan a makabael a mangdaer iti mabayag iti maysa a determinado a panangraut.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Idi 1480s, idi inrugi nga inpatakder ni Lord Hastings daytoy, ti pagilian ket nakappia ken masapul laeng ii depensa kontra kadagiti babassit a grupo ti agsursursor a marauders.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Ti balanse ti panagturay ket maysa idi a sistema a binirok dagiti nasion ti Europa a pagtalinaedenda ti nasional a soberania dagiti amin nga estado iti Europa.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Ti konsepto ket tapno amin a nasion iti Europa ket masapul a lapdanda ti maysa a nasion nga agbali a nabileg, isu a dagiti nasional a gobierno ket kanayonda a baliwan dagiti aliansada tapno mapagtalinaed ti kinabalanse.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Naimarka nga umuna a gubat ti Spanish Succession War a ti kangrunaan a pakaseknanna ket ti balanse ti bileg.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Minarkaan daytoy ti napateg a panagbaliw, a dagiti bileg ti Europa ket awananen iti panagpammarang a kas relihioso a gubgubat. Gapuna a ti Tallopulo a Tawen a Gubat ti maudin a gubat a maawagan a kas relihioso a gubat.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Nadadael ti Templo ni Artemis idiay Ephesus idi Hulyo 21, 356 BCE ti maysa a panaguram nga inaramid ni Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Segun iti istoria, ti motibasionna ket kinalatak uray ania ti katukadna. Nakagura dagiti Ephesian ket inwaragawagda a saan a pulos a mairekord ti nagan ni Herostratus.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Idi agangay, insurat ti Griego a historiador a ni Strabo dayta a nagan kas pagaammotayo itan. Nadadael ti templo iti isu met la a rabii a nayanak ni Alejandro a Dakkel.
