eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Ni Alejandro, kas ari, indiayana ti agbayad tapno maaramid manen ti templo, ngem saan a napatgan ti diayana. Idi kuan, kalpasan a matay ni Alejandro, naaramid manen ti templo idi 323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Seguraduem a nakarelaks ti imam bayat a husto a tamaam dagiti nota - padasem met a saan a mangaramid ti makabannog la unay a garaw ti ramramay mo.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Iti kastoy a wagas, bannogem bassit dayta bagim agingga a kabaelam. Tandaanam a dimo kasapulan a puersaen unay a talmegan dagiti teklado para iti ekstra a kapigsa a kas iti piano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: No usarem ti akordion, tapno manayonam ti pigsana, usarem dagiti yubuyoban nga adda nayonna a pigsa wenno pardas.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Ti Mistisismo ti panangdanon iti komunion , pannakaam-ammo, ken siririing a pagpanunot ti maysa a ultimo a realidad, dibinidad, espiritual a kinaagpayso, wenno Dios.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Dagiti mamati ket agsapsapul iti direkta a kapapadasan, kapanunotan, wenno panangtalyaw iti nasantuan a realidad/iti dios wenno dagiti dios.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Ar-aramiden dagiti pasurot ti sumagmamano a wagas ti panagbiag , wenno ar-aramid a nairanta tapno taraknenna dagidiay a kapadasan.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mailasin ti mistisismo kumpara ti dadduma pay a klase ti relihioso a pammati ken panagdayaw babaen iti panagpaganetgetna iti direkta a personal a kapadasan ti naisabsabali nga estado ti kapuotan, partikular ti natalna, nainsiriban, naragsak, ken uray pay ekstatiko a pakailadawan.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Iti Sikhismo ket relihion naggapu ti sub-kontinente ti Inda. Namungay idiay rehion ti Punjab agdama iti 15 a siglo gapu iti panagsina ti sekta iti uneg ti tradision ti Hindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Ibilang dagiti Sikh a ti pammatida ket maisina a relihion naggapu iti Hinduismo ngem bigbigbigenda ti puonna ket Hindu ken dagiti kaugalian.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Awagan dagiti Sikh ti relihionda a Gurmat, nga isu ket Punjabi para ti “dalan iti guru”. Ti guru ket pundamental nga aspeto ti amin a relihion idiay India ngem ti Sikhismo innalana ti kinapateg a mangporma iti tengnga ti pammati ti Sikh.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Ti relihion ket naipasdek idi maika-15 a siglo ni Guru Nanak (1469—1539). Adda simmaruno a siam pay a guru.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Ngem, idi June 1956, dagiti kari ni Krushchev ket napadasan kadagiti gulo iti Poland, no sadinno a dagiti trabahador ket nagprotesta kontra iti kaawan ti makan ken kaltas iti sahod, ket nagbalin a protesta kontra iti Komunismo.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Uray no idi udina, nangibaon ni Krushchev kadagiti tangke a pakigubat tapno mapasubli ti talna, pinatganna met dagiti dawat a pang-ekonomia ken immanamong iti pannakaisaad ti nalatak a tao a ni Wladyslaw Gomulka kas baro a primero ministro.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Iti Sibilisasion iti Indus Valley ket maysa a sibilisasion idi Panawen ti Bronse idiay amianan-laud iti subkontinente ti India a masaklawna ti adu a moderno a panawen a Pakistan ken mano a rehiyon idiay amianan-laud iti India ken aminanan-daya ti Afghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Dimmur-as ti sibilisasion kadagiti tanap a pagay-ayusan ti Karayan ti Indus nga isu ti nakapanagananna.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Uray no pattapattaen dagiti dadduma nga iskolar nga agsipud ta adda met sibilisasion kadagiti tantanap ti namagaan itan a Karayan Sarasvati, maiparbeng a maawagan daytoy a Sibilisasion ti Indus-Saravatsi, idinto nga awagan dagiti dadduma a kas Sibilisasion ti Harappan a naipasurot iti Harappa, a ti umuna kadagiti pakasarakan iti daytoy ket a nakali idi 1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Ti militaristiko a galad ti emperyo Romano ket nakatulong iti panangiyuswat ti medikal a panagpasango.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Nirugian ni Emperador Augustus ti nagawis kadagiti doktor ken binukelna pay ti umuna a Romano a Medical Corps a mausar iti panagleppas dagiti gubgubat.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Dagiti siruhano ket addaan iti sursuro panggep iti nadumaduma a sedatibo karaman ti morphine gapo iti tubbog ti bukel ti poppy ken scopolamine gapo iti bukel ti herbane.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Limmaingda iti panagputed tapno maisalakan dagiti pasiente manipud iti gangrene kasta met kadagiti panangbedbed ken panangipit ti urat tapno malapdan ti panagayus ti dara.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Malpas iti adu a siglo, ti imperio ti Romano ket nangiturong iti naindaklan a gungona iti tay-ak ti medisina ken nakabukel ti adu a pannakaammo nga ammo tayo tatta.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Ti Pureland origami ket origami nga adda pammaritna a maysa-maysa laeng a kulpi ti mabalin, dagiti nakumkumplikado a kulpi kasla koma pabaliktad a kulpi ket saan a maipalubos, ken amin a kulpi ket addaan diretso nga lokasionda.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Inaramid daytoy ni John Smith idi 1970s tapno matulungan dagiti awan padasna ti panagkupin wenno dagiti saan unay a makagaraw.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Dagiti ubbing ket maaddaan ti pannakaammo iti puli ken panangmatmat iti rasa ti kinaubing ken dagitoy a panangmatmat iti rasa ket makaapektar iti kababalin.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Kas pagarigan, dagiti ubbing a malasin nga adda iti minoridad a puli a matmataenda a saan a nalaing iti eskuelaan ket mabalin a saanton nga aglaing iti eskuelaan apaman a maammuanda ti panangmatmata kadakuada a mainaig iti pulida.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: Ti MySpace ti maikatlo a nasudi a website nga us-usaren ti Estados Unidos ken addaan iti agdama nga 54 milion a profile.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Dagitoy a website ket nakaala ti adu nga atension, nangruna Iti kasasaad iti panagadal.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Adu ti positibo nga aspekto dagitoy a website, pakairamanan ti, panagbalin nga alisto a panakaiplastar ti panid iti klase a mabalin a pakairaman ti blog, video, ladawan, ken naduma-duma pay a banbanag.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Daytoy a panid ti nalaka a papanan babaen ti panangted ti maysa a direksion ti web, a palakaenna a malagip ken nalaka nga i-type para kadagiti estudiante a marigatan a mangusar ti keyboard wenno ti speling.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Mabalinmo a sukatan tapno nalaka a basaen wenno adda ti ad-adu wenno basbassit a kulay no kayatmo.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Ti Sakit iti Panagkurang iti Atension “ket maysa a sakit iti panunot a dagiti tallo a klasiko a kaipapanananna a sintomas ket pakairamanan ti kinadarusudos, pannakaiyaw-awan, ken iti kinaalikuteg wenno nalabes nga enerhia”.
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Saan a pakarigatan nga agsursuro daytoy, maysa a sakit daytoyiti panagsursuro; daytoy ket “makaapekto iti 3 agingga 5 a porsiento ti amin nga ubbing, a mabalin a kas kaadu ti 2 milion nga ubbing nga Amerikano”.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Dagiti ubbing nga adda ADD na ket marigatan nga agpokus kadagiti banbanag a kas iti trabaho idiay eskuela, ngem makapokus da kadagiti banbanag a kas ti panagay-ayam wenno panagbuya ti paborito da a cartoon wenno panangisurat ti sentensia nga awan puntuasion na.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Mabalin a maisagmak dagitoy nga ubbing iti adu a pakarubuan, gapu ta "addaanda kadagiti napeggad a galgalad, makiramramanda kadagiti panagaapa, ken karitenda ti autoridad” tapno maparegtada ti utekda, ta saan a maparegta dagiti utekda babaen iti normal a panglakagan.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Apektaran ti ADD ti relasion kadagiti kakadua gapu ta dagiti dadduma nga ub-ubbing saanda a maawatan no apay a kasdiay ti panagtigtignayda wenno apay nga agispelingda ti kasdiay a pamay-an wenno ti kinamataenganda ket naidumduma.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Bayat ti abilidad a makaala ti laing ken makasursuro ket nagbaliw ti dalan a naibaga a nangatngato iti kapaspas ti laing ket maala ket nagbaliw.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Ti pamuspusan tapno makaala ti impormasion ket sabalin. Saanen a makalagip ti tao gapu iti panangpilit, ngem ti kabaelan a makalagip ti surat ket maigapu iti naipamaysa nga atension.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Iti pakabuklanna, nangaramid ti Renaissance iti napateg a panagbalbaliw iti wagas ti panagsursuro ken iti pannakaiwaras ti pannakaammo.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Saan a kas kadagiti dadduma a sunggo, saanen nga usaren dagiti hominids dagiti imada tapno aggaraw wenno masuportaran ti dagsen wenno panagkalumbitin iti kaykayo.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Agpada ti kadakkel ken kaatiddog dagiti ima ken saka ti chimpanzee, a mangipasimudaag iti usar ti ima a pangsuporta iti dagsenna no magna nga usarenna dagiti gemgem ti imana.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: TI ima ti tao ket ab-ababa ngem iti saka, nga addaan nadirdiretso a tulang.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Dagiti fossil a tulang ti ima ket addaan iti dua a milion agingga iti tallo a milion a tawen a nangipalgak ti daytoy a pagbaliwan iti pannakaisansangayanna dayta ima agsipud iti panaggaraw agingga iti panangpaandar.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Mamati dadduma a tattao a ti pannakapadas iti adu nga artipisial a pannakapasamak ti nalaka a maawatan a tagtagainep a masansan ket makabannog la unay.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Ti kangrunaan a rason ti daytoy a penomenon ket ti resulta dagiti nauneg a tagtagainep nga agwaras iti kaatiddog ti oras ti nagbaetan ti estado ti REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Kinaadda ti manmano a REM kada rabii, daytoy nga estado a mapadasam no maturogka ken iti bagim ket makaungar agbalin a saan a kanayon ket mabalin nga agbalin a problema.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Makabannog met la daytoy a kasla agriingka iti tunggal duapulo wenno tallopulo a minuto sa agbuya iti TV.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Ti epektona ket nakadepende no mamin-ano nga ipadas ti utakmo ti panagtagtagainep ti nauneg tunggal rabii.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Adda ti saan a nasayaat a napasamak kadagiti Italiano idiay Amianan nga Africa manipud pay idi rugi. Iti uneg ti maysa a Domingo ti pannakaiyebkas ti Italia iti gubat idi Hunio 10, 1940, iti maika-11 a British Hussars ket pinarmekda ti Fort Capuzzo idiay Libya.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Iti maysa a pagtambang idiay daya iti Bardia, natiliw dagiti Briton iti Panguluen nga Inhinyero iti Maikasangapulo a Buyot iti Italia, ni Heneral Lastucci.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Idi Hunio 28, ni Marshal Italo Balbo, Gobernador-Heneral ti Libya ken agtawid kenni Mussolini, ket napapatay ti mannakigayyem nga apoy bayat nga agdisdisso idiay Tobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Iti moderno a isport ti fencing ket maay-ayam ti adu nga lebel, manipud kadagiti estudiante nga agad-adal iti unibersidad agingga kadagiti propesional ken pannakilaban idiay Olympics.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Daytoy nga isport ket kangrunaanen a maay-ayam iti duelo a pormat, maysa a fencer a makiduelo iti maysa pay.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Ti golf ket maysa nga ay-ayamga dagiti agay-ayam ket mangusarda ti klab tapno tumiro iti bola a mapan kadagiti abut.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Sangapulo-ket-walo nga abut ti maay-ayam iti gagangay a round, a gagangay a mangrugi dagiti agay-ayam iti umuna nga abut iti course ken agleppas iti maikasangapulo-ket-walo.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Ti agay-ayayam nga adda ti kabassitan a panagtirona, wenno panangindayonna iti dayta a malo, tapno makumpleto dayta kurso ket isu ti mangabak.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Ti ay-ayam ket maaramid iti karuotan, ket ti ruot iti aglawlaw ti abut ket maarbasan ket maawagan iti green.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Nalabit a dagiti kadawyan a kita ti turismo ket dagiti maipanggep iti panagbiahe: Panaglinglingay a turismo.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Daytoy ket ti panagpasiar dagiti tattao iti maysa a lugar a naiduma unay iti gagangay nga inaldaw nga aktibidadda tapno agrelaks ken agragsakda.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Dagiti baybay, theme parks ken camp grounds ket masansan a gagangay a lugar a kanayon a bisitaen dagiti managlinglingay a turista.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: No ti kaipapanan ti panagbisita ti maysa iti partikular a lugar ket ti panangam-ammo iti napalabas ken kulturana ket daytoy a klase ti turismo ket maawagan a kultural a turismo.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Mabalin a bumisita dagiti turista iti nadumaduma a landmark ti maysa a pagilian wenno mabalin a pilienda a maysa laeng a lugar ti papananda.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Ti Colonist, makitana dagitoy nga aktibidad, ket nangayab metten kadagiti tumulong.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Mairaman kadagiti tropa a mangpappapigsa kadagiti paabante a posision ti umuna ken maikatlo a rehimento ti New Hampshire nga addaan 200 a buyot, iti babaen da  Koronel John Stark ken Koronel James Reed (agpada a nagbalin a heneral kalpasanna).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Nagpuesto dagiti tao ni Stark iti ayan ti alad iti amianan a pungto ti ayan dagiti Colonista.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Idi nagaramid ti giwang ti panagugot idiay Karayan Mystic idiay amianan a daya ti peninsula, pinartakanda nga inatiddagan ti bakod babaen iti panagusar ti ababa a pader a bato a mapan amianan agingana iti igid ti baybay idiay bassit nga aplaya.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Ni Gridley wenno ni Spark nangikabil iti tugkel nga agarup 100 kadapan (30 m) ti kaadayona iti sango ti alad ket order nga awan ti agpaputok aginga a malabsan daytoy dagiti regular.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Agpannuray ti plano ti America iti panangiwayat iti agtutunos a panangatake manipud iti tallo nga agduduma a direksion.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Mangisayangkat ni Heneral John Cadwalder iti panagraut a mangisiasi kontra kadagiti garison ti Briton iti Bordentown, tapno malapdanda ti aniaman a sumangpet a nayon a puersa.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Itugot ni Heneral James Ewing ti 700 a militia a bumallasiw iti karayan idiay Trenton Ferry, samsamenda ti rangtay iti rabaw ti Assunpink Creek ken lapdanda dagiti kalaban a tropa a makatalaw.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Ballasiwen ti kangrunaan a mangdarup a puersa a 2,400 a buyot ti karayan a siam a milia manipud iti amianan ti Trenton, santo agsina iti dua a grupo, maysa ti adda iti babaen ni Greene ken maysa iti babaen ni Sullivan, tapno iwayatda ti panangraut sakbay ti parbangon.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Iti panagbaliw ti panagtaray manipud iti kakapat ti milia a mapan iti kagudua ti milia, saan unayen nga importante ti kinapardas ket ti kinaibtur ti agbalinen a nangnangruna a kasapulan.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Siempre ta maysa primera klase a tumataray iti kaguadua-milia, maysa a tao a makaparmek iti dua a minuto, masapul nga addaan iti patas a kaadu ti kinapegges, ngem masapul a mataraken ti kinaandur iti amin a pagpeggadan.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Ti sumagmamano a panagtaray a cross country no tiempo ti lam-ek, a makaduaan iti panagsanay iti gymnasium para iti akingngato a bagi, ti kasayaatan a panagsagana para iti panawen ti panagtaray.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Ti nasayaat a pamay-an para iti salun-at laeng ket saan a makagapu ti nasayaat a panangaramid, ngem maapektaranda ti kangrunaanga salun-at ti naubing nga atleta.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Ti panangmantenir ti balanse ti nasalun-at a pigsa, panangaramid ti epektibo nga ugali nga uminom ti danum, ken ti pannakaawat ti naduma-duma nga aspeto ti kaugalian a panangnayon ket makatulong kadagiti agay-ayam a paimbagen ti magapuanan ken manayunan ti rag-oda iti dayta nga ay-ayam.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Saan a nangina nga sport ti middle distance a panagtaray; nupay kasta, adu dagiti  saan nga umisu a panangipapan iti sumagmamano nga alikamen a kasapulan tapno makasali.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Dagiti produkto ket mabalin a magatang no kasapulan, ngem kaadwan ket addaan ti bassit wenno awan agpayso nga itedna.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Mabalin a marikna dagiti atleta a kaykayatda ti maysa a produkto uray awan ti agpayso a benepisiona daytoy.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Makuna a ti atom ket maysa kadagiti kangrunaan a pakaaramidan iti amin a banag.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Sobra a kumplikado daytoy a banag a bukbuklen, sigun iti nasimple a modelo ti Bohr, iti tengnga a nucleus a palpalikusan dagiti electron, ket kasla kapada dagiti palenta a mangparparikus iti init - kitaem ti Pigura 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Addaan dua a partikulo ti nukleo - dagiti neutron ken dagiti proton.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Dagiti proton ket addaan iti positibo a kuryente ngem ti neutron ket awan. Dagiti electron ket adda ti negatibo a kuryentena.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: No sukimaten ti biktima, masapul a kitaen nga umuna ti nakapasamakanna tapno masigurado ti kinatalged.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Masapul a madlawmo ti posision ti biktima kabayatan ti yaasidegmo kenkuana kasta met kadagiti automatiko a negatibo a pakdaar.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: No mapasaktanka iti panangpadasmo a tumulong, mabalin a pakpakaruem laeng dagiti bambanag.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Sigun iti dayta a panagadal, naduktalan nga adda epekto ti depresion, panagbuteng ken panangpanunot iti dakes iti relasion ti ut-ot ken disabilidad dagiti agpaspasar iti ut-ot iti makinbaba a likudda.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Dagiti laeng epekto ti panagdandanaf, saan a depresion ken buteng ti kondisional iti regular a linawas a naurnos a PA a sessions.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Dagiti tumabuno iti regular nga aktibidad ket kasapulan ti ad-adu a suporta babaen ti negatibo a pannakaawat iti ut-ot a maiduma iti nagsabalian ti napaut nga ut-ot ken sakit a marikna gapu iti normal a panaggaraw iti pisikal.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: TI panagkita, wenno ti pannakabalin a makakita ket nakadepende iti organ a pangrikna ti sistema bisual wenno dagiti mata.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Adu ti agduduma a pannakaaramid dagiti mata, nakadepende ti kinakomplikadona iti kasapulan ti organismo
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Ti nadumaduma a panagaramid ket agsasabali ti kabaelanna, sensitiboiti nadumaduma a wave-length ken addaan iti agsasabali a digri ti katadem, ken masapulda ti nadumaduma a panagproseso tapno mapagbalin ti input ken nadumaduma a numero tapno agubra a nasayaat.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Ti populasion ket koleksion ti organismo iti partikular a sebbangan ti maysa a lugar.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: No agpapada amin a tattao iti populasion no maipanggep iti maysa a nangruna a phenotypic a galad, am-ammo isuda a kas monomorphic.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: No dagiti indibidual ket mangipakita ti nadumaduma a klase ti kangrunaan a kababalin isuda ket polymorphic.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Agmamartsa dagiti pangen ti koton ken kasta met nga agumokda iti nadumaduma a paset.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Iti nomadic a tiempo, dagiti soldado a kuton ket agmartsai ti rabii ken agsardeng iti aldaw.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Nangrugi ti kolonia ti nomadic a tiempo idi bimmasiten ti maalda a makan. Kabayatanna daytoy, ti kolonia ket agar-aramid ti sinsinan a pagiananda a mabaliwan iti innaldaw.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Agpaut iti aganay a 17 nga aldaw tunggal maysa kadagitoy a nomadic a panagranggas wenno panagmartsa.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Ania ti selula? Ti sao a selula ket naggapu iti Latin a pagsasao a “cella”, kayatna a sawen ket “bassit a kuarto”, ket immuna nga inawagan daytoy iti microscopist a mangpalpaliiw iti istruktura ti cork.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Ti selula ti kangrunaan a yunit ti amin a nabiag a banag, ken amin nga organismo ket buklen ti maysa wenno ad-adu pay a selula.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Nangruna ken napateg la unay dagiti selula iti panagadal iti biag, kinapudnona, masansan a dagitoy ti maaw-awagan a kas “dagiti bloke a pakabangonan ti biag”.
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Iti Sistema ti Nerbo ket tagtaginayonenna ti panagtalinaed ti panangipaw-itna ti impulses ti nerbo iti buo a bagi tapno agtultuloy ti pannagna ti dara ken saan nga agsardeng.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Dagitoy a pulso ti urat ket mabalin a maipatulod a dagus iti amin a paset ti bagi a makatulong a mapatalinaed a natalged ti bagi iti aniaman a mabalin a pagpeggadan.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Timmama dagiti ipu-ipo iti bassit a lugar kompara iti dadduma a naranggas a bagyo, ngem madadaelda ti aniaman a madalananda.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Paruten dagiti tornado dagiti kaykayo, lekkabenna dagiti diding dagiti pasdek istruktura, ken ipalladawna dagiti kotse iti tagangatang. Agpaut laeng iti nasurok a tallo nga oras ti dua porsiento kadagiti kararangragsan a tornado.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Dagiti nakaam-amak a bagyo ket addaan ti angin nga agingga ti 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Agar-aramid ken agus-usaren dagiti tattao ti lente tapno mapadakkelda dagiti bambanag manipud itt rinibribu a tawen.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Nupay kasta, naaramid ti immuna a teleskopio iti Europa idi arinunos ti maika-16 a siglo.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Agusar dagitoy a teleskopio iti kombinasion ti dua a lente tapno maipakita dagiti adayo a bambanag nga agpada a kas as-asideg ken dakdakkel.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Addanto a kanayon kadatayo ti kinaagum ken kinamanagimbubukod ket isu ti nakairuaman a panagkakadua a no ti ad-adu ket agganab kanayon nga ad-adunto ti magun-od iti apagbiit babaen ti panagbalin a managimbubukod.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Sapay koma ta mapanunot ti kaaduan a tattao a ti kasayaatan nga aramidenda ket ti sangsangkamaysa a pannakipagtraho iti sabsabali.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Adu a tattao ti agar-arapaap iti maysa nga aldaw n--a dagiti tattao ket mabalin a mapan iti sabali a bituen ken mangsursor iti nadumaduma a lubong, dadduma a tattao ket agpanpanunot no ania ti adda idiay sumagmamano ti mamati nga adda ti alien wenno sabali a biag iti sabali a planeta.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ngem, no man mapasamak daytoy ket saan nga agbayag. Agiinnadayo dagiti bituen ta trinilion a milia ti distansia ti agkarruba a bituen.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Baka iti masanguanan, dagiti appokoyo iti tumeng ket addadanton iti ngatuen ti lubong dagiti alien nga agsidsiddaaw kadagiti inapoda iti napalabas.
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Dagiti ayup ket buklen ti adu a selula. Manganda ken tunawenda iti unegda. Kaaduan nga ayup ket makagaraw.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Dagiti ayup laeng ti adda utekna (nupay saan nga amin nga ayup ketdi; kas pagarigan ti jellyfish, awan utekna).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Dagiti ayup ket makita iti entero a daga. Agkalida iti daga, aglangoy iti baybay, ken tumayab iti tangatang.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Ti maysa a selula ti kababassitan a yunit nga adda istruktura ken usarna iti maysa a sibibiag a (banag) organismo.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Iti selula ket naggapu iti sao Latin a cella a kayatna sawen bassit a kuarto.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: No kitaem dagiti sibibiag a bambanag babaen ti mikroskopio, makitam nga isuda ket naaramid iti babassit a kuadrado ken nagtimbukel.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Ni Robert Hooke, maysa a biologo a naggapu idiay Inglatera, ket nakakita iti babassit a kuadrado iti cork idi inusarna ti mikroskopiyo.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Kakasla siled ti langada. Isuna ti kaunaan a tao a nangpaliiw kadagiti natay a selula.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Dagiti elemento ken compound ket mabalin nga umakar-akar ngem saan nga agbaliw.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Addaan pay laeng dagiti pagpadaan ti nitrogen a kas gas iti likido a nitrogen. Napuspuskol ti kasasaad a likido ngem isu met laeng dagiti molecule,
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Ti danum ket maysa pagarigan. Ti compound a danum ket addaan iti dua nga atomo iti hidroheno ken maysa nga atomo iti oksiheno.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Addaan daytoy iti agpada a molekular nga istruktura no man pay daytoy ket maysa a gas, likido wenno solido.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: No man pay mabalin agbaliw ti langana, ti kemikal nga estadona ketsaan nga agbaliw.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Daytoy ket maysa nga adda iti palibottayo, ken maapektaranna ti amin nga ar-aramidentayo, ngem narigat a maawatan.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Ti oras ket ad-adalen dagiti relihioso, pilosopo, ken sientipiko nga iskolar iti rinibu a tawenen.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Mapadasantayo ti panawen a kas iti agsasaganad a pasamak iti masanguanan agginga ita ken iti napalabas.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Ti oras ket no kasano met nga iyasping ti kinabayag (kaatiddog) dagiti mapaspasamak.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Mabalin mo a markaan ti panaglabas ti oras babaen ti panangobserbar kadagiti mauli-ulit a pasamak. Ti siklikal a pasamak ket isu kanayun a maulit-ulit a pasamak.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Dagiti kompiuter itatta ket maus-usar tapno mangmaniobra kadagiti ladawan ken video.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Mabalin a maaramid dagiti sopistikado nga animasion kadagiti kompiuter, ket umad-adun ti pannakausar daytoy a klase ti animasion iti telebision ken pelikula.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Ti musika ket masansan a mairekrekord babaen kadagiti narikot a kompiuter tapno iproseso ken paglaokenna dagiti uni.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Iti nabayag a tawen iti maikasangapulo ket siam ken maikaduapulo a siglo, pattien a dagiti immun-una a nagtalinaed idiay New Zealand ket dagiti Maori, a naganup kadagiti higante a billit a maawagan moa.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Dayta a teoria ket nangipasdek iti kapanunotan a dagiti tattao iti Maori ket immakarda a naggapu iti Polynesia iti Dakkel a Barko ken innalada iti New Zealand manipud kadagiti Moriori, pannangipasdek iti maysa a kagimongan a mannalon.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Nupay kasta, ibagbaga ti baro a pammaneknek a dagiti Moriori ket grupo dagiti mainland a Maori nga immakar manipud iti New Zealand a napan kadagiti Isla ti Chatham, ket sadiay, binukelda ti bukodda a naiduma ken natalna a kultura.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Adda met maysa pay a tribo idiay Chatham Islands dagitoy ket dagiti Maori a pimmanaw a naggapu iti New Zealand.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Inawaganda ti bagida a Moriori adda iti sumagmamano a saan a pagtitinnunusan ngem ti kamauddianna, dagiti Moriori ket napukawda.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Dagiti tattao a nairaman iti adu a dekada ket tinulunganda kami nga apresiaren ti pigsa ken rasuktayo bayat a sipupudnotayo a makita ti pakarigatan ken uray pay ti saan a pagballigian.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Kabayatan ti panagdengngeg kadagiti indibidual a mangibinglay kadagiti indibidual, pamilia, organisasional nga istoriada, makaalatayo kadagiti napateg a kapanunotan iti napalabas ken kadagiti sumagmamano a personalidad a nakaimpluensia para iti pagsayaatan man wenno pagdaksan ti kultura ti organisasion.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Bayat a tartarusam ti pakasaritaan ti maysa saanmo nga ipagarup a matarusam met ti kultura, ngem makatulong met kadagiti tattao a makagun-od iti rikna no sadino ti nakaibatuganda ti pakasaritaan ti organisasion.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Bayat nga ad-adalen kadagiti panagballigi ken agbalin a naammo kadagiti pannakapaay, dagiti tattao ken ti amuin a nakiraman a tattao ket makadiskubre iti naun-uneg nga addaan pateg, panggep, ken pigsa a mangiturturong iti organisasion.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Iti daytoy a kanito, ti pananglagip iti napalabas a garaw ti panagnegosio ken dagiti balligi ket nakatulong kadagiti tattao nga agbalin a nakalukat kadagiti baro a panagbaliw ken baro a turong para iti lokal a simbaan.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Mangkissay iti panagamak iti panagbalbaliw dagita nga istoria ti panagballigi, kabayatan a mangparparnuay kadagiti positibo a pagannayasan para iti panagbaliw iti masakbayan.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Iti disenio a managtiptipon a pagpanpanunot ket sistema ti panagsolbar ti problema a mangpamaysa iti dadduma a panunot wenno tay-ak tapno mabirukaniti pamuspusan.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Ti pokus daytoy a kapanunotan ket paspas, lohika, ken kinaumiso, mainayon pay ti panangilasin iti kinaagpayso, panangaramid manen kadagiti addan a pamay-an, panangala iti impormasion.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Ti kakapategan a banag kadagitoy a kapanunotan ket: adda laeng maysa a husto a sungbat. Makapanunotka laeng iti dua a sungbat, mainaganan ti husto ken madi.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Daytoy a klase ti panagpanunot ket mainaig iti dadduma a sensia wenno gagangay a pamay-an.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Dagiti tattao nga addaan iti kastoy a klase ti kapanunotan nga addaan iti lohikal a panagpampanunot, ket makabael nga agikabesa kadagiti disenio, mangsolbar kadagiti problema ken agobra kadagiti a sientipiko a panangsubok.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Dagiti tattao pay laeng ti kalalaingan nga species iti panangbasa iti panunot ti sabali.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Kayatna a sawen a kabaelantayo a pugtuan no ania ti makitkita, gandat, patien, ammo wenno tarigagay ti sabali a tattao.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Kadagitoy nga abilidad, napateg ti pannakaawat iti gagara ti sabali. Palubosannatayo a mangsolbar kadagiti posible a saan a nalawag a pisikal a paspasamak.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Kas pagarigan, no makakitaka iti tao a magperperdi iti tawa ti lugan, maipagarupmo nga isuna ket agtatakaw ti lugan ti sabali a tao.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Sabali koma ti pannaka-ukomna no napukawna ti tulbek ti lugan ken no kukuana ti lugan a serserkenna.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Ti MRI ket naibasar iti penomena iti pisika a maawagan iti nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), a nadiskubre idi dekada 1930 da Felix Bloch (agtrabtrabaho iti Stanford University) ken Edward Purcell (manipud iti Harvard University).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Iti daytoy nga aweng, ti magnetic field ken dagiti radio wave ti mangigapu kadagiti atom a mangparnuay kadagiti babassit ti signal ti radio.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Idi tawen ti 1970, nadiskobre ni Raymond Damadian, maysa a doktor ti medisina ken sientista nga agad-adal, ti pangibasaran ti panangusar iti magnetic resonance imaging a kas maysa a remienta para iti medikal a diagnosis.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Kalpasan ti uppat a tawen, naikkan iti patente, ket dayta ti kaunaan a patente iti intero a lubong iti tay-ak ti MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Idi 1977, nalpas ni Dr. Damadian ti pannakaaramid iti immuna a “bui a bagi” a MRI scanner, nga inawaganna nga “Indomitable”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Ti agsisinnublat a pannakisarita ti mangitunda iti oras ti panangpanpanunot ken reaksion ti sabali.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Palubusan daytoy dagiti estudiante iti abilidadda nga agtrabaho iti bukodda a kinapartak ken makontrol ti impormason nga instruksional.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Kanayunanna pay, adda laeng sumagmamano a restriksion ket agbalinto met laeng a nawaywaya ti eskediulmo iti trabaho. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Ti panagusar iti Internet ken World Wide Web, palubosanna dagiti agsursuro a maaddaan iti acces iti impormasion iti aniaman nga oras.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Mabalin met a mangted dagiti estudiante kadagiti salsaludsod para kadagiti mangisursuro iti uray ania nga oras iti aldaw ket namnamaenda ti napartak a pannakasungbat, imbes nga agurayda agingga iti sumaruno a panagsasango.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Ti postmodern approach iti panagadal ket mangipaay ti wayawaya, Awan ti maymaysa a dalan iti panagsursuro.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Kinapudnona, awan ti uray maysa laeng a naimbag a banag a masursuro. Mapasamak ti pannakasursuro iti kapadasan iti nagbaetan ti agsursuro ken ti pannakaammo a naiparang.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Iti madama a kapadasantayo maipapan kadagiti amin nga aramidem-a-siksika ken panagpresenta iti impormasion, dagiti pabuya a naibasar iti pannakaammo ket mailadawanna daytoy a punto.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Adu kadatayo ti maayatan a makabuya iti maysa a programa iti telebision a mangipakaammo kadatayo iti maysa a proseso wenno kapadasan a saantayonto met pakairamanan wenno mausar dayta a pannakaammo.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Saankam pulos agoverhaul ti lugan, agaramid ti fountain iti arubayanmi, mapan idiay Peru tapno kitaen dagiti agkakauna a rebba, wenno baliwan iti balay ti kaarrubami.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Pagyamanan dagiti adda iti lansad ti baybay a link ti fiber optic cable iti Europa ken broadband satellite, konektado a nasayaat ti Greenland ket 93% ti populasionna ti addaan access iti internet.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Ti hotelmo wenno ti agpadagus kenka (no sika ket agtalinaed iti balay ti bisita wenno pribado a balay) ket mabalin a maaddaan iti wifi wenno internet a nakakonektar iti kompiuter, ken amin a sitio ket adda ti internet caféna wenno dadduma a lugar ket adda iti wifi para iti publiko.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Kas naibaga idiay ngato, nupay ti sao nga “Eskimo” ket maakseptar latta idiay Estados Unidos, maibilang daytoy kas makaipababa kadagiti adu nga Antarktiko a tattao a saan a taga-U.S., kangrunaan ti Canada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: No man mangngegam dagiti sasao nga us-usaren dagiti Katutubo ti Greenland, ti panagusar dagitoy ket masapul a liklikan dagiti dayo.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Ti lokal nga aggigiyan iti Greenland ket ninagananda ti bagbagida nga Inuit idiay Canada ken Kalaalleq (Kalaallit no aduda), maysa a Greenlander, diay Greenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Ti krimen, ken kinadakes a panunot para kadagiti tagaruar ti pagilian, ket saanmo makita idiay Greenland. Idiay man ilida, awan dagiti “nasayaat a luglugar.”
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Mabalin a ti laeng nalamiis a panawen ti pudpudno a peggad a sanguen ti saan a nakasagana.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: No agpasiarka idiay Greenland kadagiti panawen a kalamiisna (no ad-adayo ti papanam nga agpaamianan, lumamlamiis met), kasapulan ti panangitugot iti bado a para lam-ek
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Dagiti nakabaybayag nga aldaw ti pinagbabara ket mabalin a mangited dagiti problema ti panagala ti umdas a turog ken mairaman a saksakiten.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: No madama ti kalgaw, siputanyo met dagiti lamok a Nordic. Uray no saanda a makaited iti aniaman a saksakit, makasinga dagitoy.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Bayat iti ekonomia ti San Francisco ket nainaig ti pannaka primera klase a pagpasiaran dagiti turista, iti ekonomia ket nadumaduma.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Dagiti kadadakkelan a sektor ti pagtrabahuan ket dagiti propesional a serbisio, gobierno, finance, panagnegosio, ken turismo.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Nakatulong ti kanayon a pannakailadawanna kadagiti musika, pelikula, literatura ken nalatak a kultura tapno mabigbig ti siudad ken dagiti pagpasiaranna a nalatak iti sibubukel a lubong.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Ti San Francisco ket nakabukel iti dakkel nga imprastraktura ti turista nga addaan iti adu a hotel, panganan, ken nangato a klase a pasilidad ti kombension.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Ti San Francisco ket maysa met kadagiti kasayaatan a lugar iti nasion para kadagiti dadduma pay a makan a pang-Asia: Korean, Thai, Indian, ken Japanese.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Ti panagbiahe iti Walt Disney World ket mangireprepresentar iti pilgrimage iti adu a pamilia nga Amerikano.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Iti maysa a “gagangay” a panagbisita ket mairaman iti panagtayab a mapan idiay Orlando International Airport, aglugan ti bus a mapan idiay Disney hotel , agtalinaed sadiay iti maysa a lawas a saan a rumrumuar ti sanikua ti Disney, ken agawid idiay balay.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Adda dagiti mabalin nga awan limitasionna a panagbaliwbaliw, ngem daytoy latta ti kayat a sawen ti kaaduan a tao no ibagada a “mapan idiay Disney World”.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Adu a tiket a mailaklako iti online babaen kadagiti website a para auction kas iti eBay wenno Craigslist ti nausaren ti dadduma a partena a tiktiket a multi-day a para kadagiti park-hopper.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Nupay gagangay nga aktibidad, daytoy ket iparparit ti Disney: dagiti tiket ket saan a maiyakar.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Aniaman a panagkampo idiay baba iti igid ti Grand Canyon ket kasapulanna ti backcountry permit.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Limitado dagiti permiso tapno maprotektaran ti ginget, ken mabalin a nawadwad inton umuna nga aldaw ti bulan, uppat a bulan sakbay ti rugi ti bulan.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Isu a ti permiso a backcountry para iti aniaman a rugi nga aldaw ti Mayo ket mabalin a maala iti 1 ti Enero.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Ti espasio para kadagiti kalalatakan a lugar, kas ti Bright Angel Campground kaabay ti Phantom Ranch, kangrunaan a mapunno dagiti umawat iti umuna a petsa nga aglukatda para iti panagpareserba.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Adda ti manmano a numero ti permiso para kadagiti walk-in a kiddaw a magun-odan ti basar a no sino ti umuna a sumangpet, isu met ti umuna a maikkan.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Nasayaat a wagas ti iseserrek iti Umabagatan nga Africa babaen ti kotse tapno makita amin a kinapintas ti rehion ken tapno makadanon kadagiti lugar nga awan kadagiti normal a ruta dagiti turista.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Daytoy ket mabalin a maaramid iti normal a lugar nga adda iti napasnek a panagplano ngem iti 4x4 ket natagipateg a pamalbalakad ken iti adu a lugar ket madanon laeng iti nangato a base iti pilid a 4x4.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Panunotem a bayat nga agplanplanoka nga uray no ti Makinbagatan nga Africa ket natalged, dagiti kaarrubana a pagilian ket saan.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Dagiti kasapulan para iti Visa ken iti bayadna ket agsabali depende iti nasion ken maapektaran met iti nasion a paggapuam.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Kada pagilan ket adda ti sabsabali a turay a mangibaga no ania dagiti pang-emerhensia a bambanag iti uneg ti lugan.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Ti Victoria Falls ket maysa nga ili idiay laud a parte ti Zimbabwe, ballasiw iti daraitan aggapu Livingstone, Zambia, ken asideg iti Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Ti ili ket kaabay a mismo ti dissuor, ket dagita ti kangrunaan nga atraksion, ngem daytoy nalatak a pagpasiaran dagiti turista ket mangted iti adu nga oportunidad tapno agtalinaed ditoy a napapaut dagiti agsapsapul iti ragragsak ken agsapsapul iti napintas a lugar.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: No panagtutudo (Nobiembre agingga Marso), ti kadakkel ti danum ket nangatngato ken ti Busay ket napigpigsa.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Sigurado a mabasaka no ballasiwem ti rangtay wenno magnaka kadagiti desdes nga agrikus iti asideg ti Falls.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Ti sabali a bangir, sigurado a gapu ta ti kinaadu ti danum ket nangato ti panagbuyam iti aktual a Falls ket malingdan—iti amin a danum!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Ti Tanem ni Tutankhamun (KV62). Ti KV62 ket maibagbaga a kasisikatan a tanem iti Valley, ti lugar iti pannakadiskubre ni Howard Carter idi 1922 ti sibubukel a nabaknang a nakaitabunan ti agtutubo nga ari.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Nupay kasta, no ikompara kadagiti kaaduan a sabali a naarian a tanem, kasla manmano a nasken a pasiaren ti tanem ni Tutankhamun, gapu ta basbassit ken awan unay ti dekorasionna daytoy.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Siasinoman nga interesado a makakita iti ebidensia ti pannakadadael ti mummy a naaramid iti madama ti panagpadas iti panagikkat kadagitoy manipud iti lungonna ket mapaay gapu ta iti ulona laeng ken abaga ti makita.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Dagiti adu a kinabaknang iti ayan ti tanem ket awanen, ngem naiyakar dagitoy iti Egyptian Museum idiay Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Dagiti bisita nga addaan iti limitado a panawen ket kasayaatan nga itedda ti orasda iti sadinoman.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Ti Phnom Krom, 12 km abagatan-laud ti Siem Reap. Daytoy a templo ti ngato iti bantay ket naaramid idi maudi a maika-9 a siglo, idi panagturay ni Ari Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Ti naliday a tangatang ti templo ken ti buya idiay dan-aw iti Tonle Sap ket mangaramid a makagungona ti panaguli ti turod.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Mabalin a kombiniente a maitipon iti panangbisita iti lugar ti panagbangka iti dan-aw.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Ti Angkor Pass ti kasapulam no umunegka iti templo isu a saanmo a liplipatan nga awiten dayta pasportmo no mapanka idiay Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Ti Jerusalem ti kapitolio ken kadakkelan a siudad ti Israel, ngem kaadduan ti dadduma a nasion ken ti United Nations saanda a bigbigen daytoy a kas kapitolio ti Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Ti kadaanan a siudad ti Judean Hills ket addaan nakaskasdaaw a pakasaritaan a mairaman iti rinibu a tawen.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Ti siudad ket nasantuan para iti tallo a monoteistiko a relihion - Hudaismo, Kristianismo ken Islam, ket agserbi nga espiritual, relihioso, ken kultural a sentro.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Gapu kadagiti relihioso a kapatgan ti siudad ken kangrunaanna iti adu a lugar ti Daan a Siudad, ti Jerusalem ket maysa kadagiti kangrunaan a destinasion dagiti turista iti Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Ti Jerusalem ket addaan iti adu nga agkakauna, arkeolohia ken kultural a lugar, kasta pay dagiti sentro ti paggatangan nga adu ti taona, pagkapean, ken panganan.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Sapulen ti Ecuador dagiti umili ti Cuba ti surat nga imbitasion sakbay a sumrekda iti Ecuador babaen kadagiti internasional nga eropuerto wenno kadagiti pagawatan iti nagbeddengan.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Daytoy a surat ket masapul nga iligalisa ti Ministro ti Foreign Affairs iti Ecuador, ken sumurot kadagiti husto a pagalagadan.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Dagitoy a kasapulan ket inaramid tapno mangited ti na-organisa nga urnos ti panagakar iti baet ti agpada a pagilian.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Dagiti umili ti Cuba nga addaan iggemna a berde a kard ti Estados Unidos ket masapul a bumisita iti Konsulada iti Ecuador tapno makaala iti pannakailisi kadagitoy a kasapulan.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Dayta pasaportem ket mabalin pay ti nakurkurang ngem 6 a bulan aglabes iti petsa ti panagbiahem. Ti tiket ti biahe nga agpapan-agawid/agpapan ket masapul tapno mapaneknekan ti bayag ti panagtalinaedmo.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Nalaklaka ti bayad dagiti tour no dakdakkel ti grupo, isu a no maymaysaka wenno maysa laeng ti kaduam, padasem ti makiam-ammo iti dadduma pay a tattao ken mangbukelkayo iti grupo nga uppat agingga iti innem ti miembrona tapno nalaklaka ti bayadan ti tunggal maysa.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Ngem, saanmo koma a baliwan daytoy, ngamen masansan a dagiti turista ket agpila tapno mapunno dagiti lugan.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Daytoy ket kasla talaga wagas ti panangloko iti tattao tapno mamatida a masapul nga agbayadda iti ad-adu pay.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Agpaparang iti ngatuen ti amianan nga ungto ti Machu Picchu ket daytoy natayag a bantay, a masansan a makita kas likudan kadagiti adu a retrato dagiti rebba.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Kasla nakabutbuteng no kitaem ti aggapu iti baba ket isu ket natadem ken narigat nga ulien, ket dagiti pinakarasonable a nasalun-at a tattao ket makayada iti uneg iti agarup 45 a minutos.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Dagiti batbato a pagpaddakan ket naidasar iti pagnaan, ken kadagiti nangatngato a paset ket dagiti landok a kable ti mangmangted iti suporta a pagigianan.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Naibagada, namnaem a maibusanka iti anges, ket aggannadka kadagiti parte a natadem, aglalo no nabasa, ket mabalin a nadaras a delikado daytoy.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Adda maysa a bassit a kueba asideg idiay ngato a masapul a dalanan, daytoy ket medio nababa ken nailet.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Ti panagkita kadagiti lugar ken dagiti atap nga animal idiay Galapagos ket nasaysayaat no nakaluganka iti bapor, a kas inubra ni Darwin idi 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Nasurok 60 a panagpasiar ti barko a lumaslasat iti danum ti Galapagos - dagiti kadakkelda ket addaan iti 8 agingga 100 a pasahero.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Kaaduan a tattao ket agpareserba a nasapa iti pagyananda (gapu ta dagiti bangka ket nadaras a mapno no panawen ti kapigsana).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Siguraduem a ti ahente a nagpapareserbaam ket maysa nga espesialista iti Galapagos nga addaan umiso a pannakaammo iti adu a klase ti barbarko.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Daytoy ket mangsigurado a dagiti naikeddeng nga interes ken/wenno lapped a naitutop kadagiti barko a nasayaat para kadakuada.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Sakbay a simmangpet dagiti Español idi maika-16 a siglo, ti makin-amianan a Chile ket naparmek ti linteg nga Inca bayat a dagiti katutubo nga Araucanian (Mapuche) ket agnanaed iti sentro ken makin-bagatan a Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Ti Mapuche ket maysa met kadagiti naudi nga agwaywayas a grupo a katutubo nga Amerikano, a saan ng amin ket agsasao iti Español kalpasan ti pannakawaywaya ti Chile.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Uray pay indeklara ti Chile iti panagwaywayasna idi 1810 (bayat iti Napoleonic a gubgubat a nangibati iti Espania nga awan ti agturturay a sentral a gobierno iti mano a tawen), ti pannangabak kontra iti Español ket saan a naaramat agingga idi 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Ti Republika Dominican (Español: Republica Dominicana) ket maysa a pagilian ti Caribbean nga adda ti makindaya a kagudua ti isla ti Hispaniola, a kabingayna ti Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Malaksid iti baybay nga adda puraw a darat ken buya iti banbantay, ti nasion ket balay iti kadaanan a siudad ti Europa idiay Americas, a paset itan ti Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Ti isla ket immuna a naggianan dagiti Tainos ken Caribes. Dagiti Caribes ti tattao nga agsasao ti Arawakan simmangpet idi agarup 10,000 BCE.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ti uneg laeng ti mano a tawen kalpasan ti panangsangpet dagiti eksplorador manipud Europa, permi a naipabassit dagiti manangraut nga Español ti populasion idiay Tainos.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Naibatay idiay Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) tenga iti 1492 ken 1498 dagiti manangparmek nga Español ket nangpatayda iti 100,000 a Taino.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Nabangon daytoy a lugar a kas atrium para iti maika-17 siglo a kombento, a ti Templo de Sandiego ti kakaisuna a nabatbati a patakder.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: An alternative translation would be: Daytoy itan ti sentro a plaza, ken kanayon nga adu latta ti mapaspasamak, bigat ken rabii.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Adu dagti restaurant iti aglawlaw ti hardin, ket no iti malem ken rabii masansan nga adda dagiti libre a konsiero iti akintengnga a gazebo.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Dalan iti Bisong). Dua a balkonahe a napagsina iti 69 a sentimetro laeng ket pagtaengan ti agkakauna nga istoria ti ayat.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Para iti mano a baria dagiti ubbing ket istoriaendaka.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Ti Isla ti Bowen ket maysa a mapadpadayawan a pagpasiaran wenno ekskursion a mabalin nga agkayak, umuli ti bantay, paggatangan, panganan ken adu pay.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Daytoy umiso a barrio a masarakan idiay Howie Sound labes laeng iti Vancouver, ken nalaka isuna a papanan bayat ti adda iskediulna a taksi ti danum a pumanaw iti Grandville Island idiay downtown ti Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Para kadagiti maragragsakan kadagiti aktibidad iti ruar, importante a mapadasanda ti magna a sumang-at iti kalsada ti Sea to Sky.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Nangina ti Whistler (1.5 nga oras a biahe manipud iti Vancouver) ngem nalatak gapu iti 2010 Winter Olympics.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Iti panawen ti lam-ek, namayat ti sumagmamano a kasasayaatan a panag-ski idiay North Amerika, ken iti kalgaw padasen ti sumagmamano a pudpudno a panagbisekleta iti bantay.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ti permiso ket masapulna ireserba nga umuna. Kasapulan nga adda iti permisona agnaedka iti agpatnag idiay Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Ti Sirena laeng ti istasion ti tagabantay a mangitukon ti paggianan a dormitorio ken napudot a makan kanayonan ti panagkampo. Ti La Leona, San Pedrillo, ken Los Patos ken mangitukon laeng ti panagkampo nga awan ti serbisio maipapan iti makan.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Mabalin a makaala kadagiti permiso a direkta manipud iti Ranger Station iti Puerto Jimenez, ngem saanda nga agawat iti credit card.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Ti Serbisio ti Parke (MINAE) ket saan a mangmangted ti permiso iti parke a nalabes ti maysa a bulan a kinasapa sakbay ti pinagsangpet.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Itukon ti CafeNet El Sol ti agur-uray a serbisio para iti gatad a US$30, wenno $10 para iti maysa-aldaw a pammalubos; detalye ket adda sadiay pahina ti Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Ti Cook Islands ket maysa nga isla a nasion nga adda nawaya a pannakainaigna iti New Zealand, a makita idiay Polynesia, ti tengnga iti Makin-abagatan a Baybay Pasipiko.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Maysa nga arkipelago nga addaan iti 15 nga isla a nakawaras iti nasurok a 2.2 milion km2 a iti taaw.
